localChanges: With the New interface preview on, the Game menu and the menu a long press opens on the map are one panel in the new style, with each item's key beside it. The item under the pointer, or under your finger as you slide, is the one chosen (#808).
With the New interface preview on, a right-click on the map opens the unit's menu straight away.
Pressing the Game menu button a second time now closes the menu, rather than opening it again (closes #710).
The menu a long press opens on the map now says "Go to" rather than "GoTo".
